tractoverse

The tractoverse is a curated collection of R packages for the analysis of diffusion MRI tractography data, inspired by the tidyverse. Installing this meta-package installs and, with library(tractoverse), attaches the whole family:

Package Role Signature color
fiber Data structures (streamline, bundle, bundle_set) #59aaea
master Simulation of streamlines / bundles / bundle sets with microstructural parameters #ff9441
rtists Interactive 3D visualization #a980fc
riot Data I/O (through rvtk) #3ec4b2
toad Tractography Open Atlases Data (companion dataset package) #ffcf1b
bot Bundle Optimal Transport; statistical methods for tractography data #3fb950

The package also ships the shared tractoverse brand — the colors, theme and logo family above — as the single source of truth reused by the individual package websites and applications. See [tractoverse_brand()] and [tractoverse_theme()].

Dependencies among the family: fiber is the root, providing the shared data structures; master, rtists, toad and riot all build on fiber; riot additionally depends on the external rvtk package for data I/O; and tractoverse (the meta-package) imports all six core packages. bot currently declares no dependencies (it will build on fiber as its statistical methods land).

Installation

The core packages are released on CRAN when available and developed on GitHub otherwise. The simplest way to bring in any selection of the family is [install_core_packages()], which prefers the CRAN release and falls back to the GitHub development branch:

# Default: install all six core packages
tractoverse::install_core_packages()

# …or just the ones you need, and force an upgrade
tractoverse::install_core_packages(c("fiber", "bot"), force = TRUE)

Once installed, load the whole family in one call:

library(tractoverse)

library(tractoverse) attaches the six core packages, so their functions (fiber::bundle(), master::simulate_bundle(), …) are directly available, and tractoverse_packages() lists the family.

Quick start 

library(tractoverse)

# The family, with each package's role
tractoverse_packages()

# Build a small bundle of streamlines with fiber
sl <- fiber::streamline(points = cbind(X = 0, Y = 0, Z = seq(0, 1, length.out = 5)))
fiber::bundle(list(sl))

The shared brand

The tractoverse visual identity is defined once in inst/brand/_brand.yml and mirrored as an R object:

tractoverse_brand()$palette
#   fiber   master   rtists     riot     toad      bot
# "#59aaea" "#ff9441" "#a980fc" "#3ec4b2" "#ffcf1b" "#3fb950"

[tractoverse_theme()] returns the path to the shared dark theme stylesheet for tractoverse Quarto / pkgdown sites.
